verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Fly Machines REST API, a published OpenAPI spec, the flyctl CLI, and an experimental flyctl MCP server, but no official language SDKs or client libraries. A REST API and OpenAPI file are building blocks a developer could use to generate or write a client; they are not the official SDKs this story asks about. Cloud platforms can plausibly ship SDKs, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
